text:
aran: uploaded an nsys trace from the canary run, seeing recurring 30-70ms stutter every ~120 requests. link: https://artifacts/internal/nsys/2968501234
mika: quick q — is this when kvcache prefetch kicks in?
aran: yes, prefetch hotpath. timeline looks like memcpy(host->device) on stream 2 then kernel on stream 0. they overlap in theory but we get a long CPU gap and then kernel stalls.
tessa: can you paste the short waterfall snapshot? I want to see stream ids + hostcopy timestamps.
aran: pasted snippet:
```
CUDA STREAM 0  kernel   0.6ms  [compute]
CUDA STREAM 2  memcpyH2D 20.4ms [hostcopy pinned]
CPU  thread  120ms sleep -> wake
kernel on S0 waits 40ms after memcpy finishes
```
aran: seems like hostcopy is using copy engine but CPU wakeup latency lines up with kernel launch queuing.
perf-bot: auto-note: build #2025 had a recent change to microbatcher: batching_heuristic.v2 enabled.
mika: that heuristic increases prefix prefetch for small sequences right? could amplify hostcopy frequency.
tessa: try a run with batching_heuristic.v2 disabled and set `PREFETCH_PARALLEL=1` for the prefetch worker.
aran: ran a short replay with flags off, stutter dropped to <5ms.
mika: suspicious — maybe heuristic pushes many small hostcopies that thrash the single copy engine and cause CPU scheduling wake churn.
aran: also saw kernel selection changed: we fall back to the int8-kernel for short sequences which uses a different CUDA stream affinity.
tessa: sounds like a cross-resource contention: copy-engine + cpu-sched + kernel stream affinity.
tracebot: recommendation: capture nsight with `--capture-range=process` + `--trace=cuda,osrt` and include `nvtx` markers for prefetch enqueue + batcher dispatch.
aran: will run that and attach next.
mika: if reproducible we should add a guard in microbatcher to coalesce small prefetches into one hostcopy per batch.
tessa: agree. also add an experiment to pin prefetch thread to isolated CPU to remove wake jitter.
aran: thanks — next steps: 1) repro w/ nsight detailed capture, 2) A/B with heuristic off, 3) prototype coalescing. will update thread with new captures. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: logged ticket PERF-3617 (kv-prefetch coalesce) based on this thread.
mika: nice. low-effort check: run `perf record -e sched:sched_wakeup` during repro to correlate wakeups.
aran: good call, adding that to capture checklist.
tracebot: reminder: attach symbolized kernels and nvtx timeline when uploading to artifacts.
aran: will do. closing for now, will post new trace when ready.
